# exif-stripper

> Strip EXIF, GPS, XMP, IPTC and comments from JPEG, PNG and WebP by rewriting container segments byte-exactly, without decoding pixels Python package `trysac-exif-stripper`, import name `exif_stripper`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
